The '''Far*Reach IV PQR''' was a type of [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The IV PQR was a heavily armed version of Loronar's popular Far Reach scout line.

==History==
The ''[[Wanderer]]'' was an Imperial Survey Vessel searching for secret Rebel colonies.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wanderer_schematic.jpg|thumb|left|100px|deckplan]]
The artwork for the deckplan of this ship was recycled from an older [[West End Games]] source. Originally this artwork was used on the 54 meter Imperial cargo shuttle also known as the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]]. This artwork originally appeared in the [[Star Wars Campaign Pack]] published in 1988 and reprinted in 1994 in [[Classic Campaigns]]. The older artwork's stats were re-sized to 80 meters in length and new exterior artwork was produced to differentiate it from the older smaller ship for the 1990 publication.
